pattern: SELECT COUNT\(*\) FROM [a-zA-Z0-9]+ WHERE Language = '[a-zA-Z]+' AND IsOfficial = '[Tt]' AND CountryCode IN \(( SELECT CountryCode FROM countrylanguage WHERE Language = '[a-zA-Z]+' AND IsOfficial = '[Tt]' )\)
correction: Replace the subquery with an INTERSECT operation to find common names of countries where either English or Dutch is an official language.

metadata.description: This rule corrects a SQL query that incorrectly uses a subquery to find common names of countries where either English or Dutch is an official language, instead of using the INTERSECT operator.
